About us

We bring together everyone Zimbabwean farming needs

Murimi Intelligent Hub is a Zimbabwean platform for farmers, landowners, investors at home and in the diaspora, and transporters. We help them find each other, trust each other and get paid fairly.

Why we exist

Good land and willing money rarely meet

Farmers have land and skills but no money for inputs. People in the diaspora want to invest at home but don't trust what they can't see. Middlemen buy crops cheaply at the farm gate.

What we do

Check, record and pay in stages

Our field officers check every farm and piece of land. Money is held in escrow and released as each stage is done. Records are kept in USD and ZiG, and prices are shared on WhatsApp.

What we stand for

Trust, openness and fair prices

Everyone sees what is happening on the farm. Nobody is paid before the work is done. Farmers sell at prices that reflect what buyers in Harare actually pay.

Who it's for

Who are you?

Pick the one that fits you best. Signing up is free and takes about two minutes.

How it works

Three steps from sign-up to harvest

01

Sign up

Tell us whether you farm, own land, want to invest or drive a truck.

02

Get verified and matched

A Murimi field officer checks every farm and piece of land. Then we match farmers, land, investors and transport.

03

Grow, sell and get paid

Money sits in escrow and is released at each stage. The harvest is sold at fair prices and everyone gets their share.
